name: The Disciples
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King

generalAbilities.name: Lifesense 30 feet
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

Lifesense allows a monster to sense the vital essence of living and undead creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rise Again
defensiveAbilities.description: If the Disciples is reduced to 0 Hit Points by means other than fire damage, disintegration, or its resurrection vulnerability, it returns to unlife at the start of its next turn. It has 45 Hit Points and is Prone in the space in which it was destroyed. The Disciples can't be returned by this ability again for 1 hour.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Agonized Howl
offensiveAbilities.description: The unrisen howls in pain at its cursed existence. Creatures within a 30ft Emanation take 6d8 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Will Saving Throw). The unrisen can't use Agonized Howl again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Awful Approach
offensiveAbilities.description: The unrisen reshapes its grotesque form to move swiftly. It Strides twice. Any living creature that can see the unrisen during this movement must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). This is a mental and visual effect. The unrisen can't use Awful Approach again for 1d4 rounds.
